theme: An open Sunday, bookended by one meeting at dusk.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The Sunday review with Mike is already behind you and nothing sits on the calendar until the DIRA & DIBA annual meeting at five. The quiet middle is a good window for the travel bookings that have waited about as long as they safely can.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the 5 PM annual meeting or send a proxy
needsAttention.detail: Mark Hoffman asked yesterday whether you're attending the DIRA & DIBA annual meeting today, or will give him or David your proxy so they have quorum. You've accepted the invite; a one-line reply settles it. Materials went out Oct 2.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority board item (overdue about six weeks). A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the thinnest rental in that market and sells out; a refundable hold now removes the risk at no cost.

needsAttention.title: Decide the December break destination
needsAttention.detail: The book-by date (Oct 15) has passed and holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the year's thinnest. The call is domestic vs. international; passports land early-to-mid November, after you'd book.

flagged.title: Two SVP public-affairs alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged a Burson SVP, Corporate & Public Affairs role and an SVP, Global Public Policy role — alerts, not outreach, but on-target.

inbox.noise: Roughly 40 promotions, shipping updates, and newsletters — nothing needing a reply.
